LightningComponentBundle.description: Shows public LinkedIn company or profile info for the URL stored in a field on the record.

property.name: urlField
property.label: LinkedIn URL Field
property.description: Field on this object that holds the LinkedIn URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/ewc-group-inc/).

property.name: fieldPath
property.label: Related Field Path (optional)
property.description: Overrides the field above to read a related record's field, e.g. Account.LinkedIn_URL__c on Contact.
